rules: Acceptance tests first (the exact titles of B11-case-map.md), then code; focused tests while working, pnpm run verify once at the end.

Extend B06, never fork it: pipeline order, runtime roles and pools, journal, outbox, closed replies, generated OpenAPI and matrix (pnpm run openapi:generate / matrix:generate), @kauro/persistence/testing.
Real PostgreSQL 17 in api and persistence tests; interleavings by hold points and pg_stat_activity lock waits, never sleeps.
A migration is numbered 0009 on the mandate's own branch; the integrator renumbers.
Only the fakes listed in owns_fakes may be created by the mandate; every fake is labelled CONTRACT_FAKE and its evidence class is SIMULATED.
No new dependency beyond the design's pins (D-STACK-1); a needed one is pinned, justified in the design and lands with its lockfile in the same commit.
English copy through apps/web/src/copy/en.ts only (A3); never the pre-rename brand.
Record per case: case | test file :: exact title | status | commit, in B11-case-map.md.
